verdict.rationale: Mailchimp docs confirm open/click tracking (docs-21, docs-22), e-commerce conversion tracking (docs-23), and Analytics AI insights into which campaigns/automations drive revenue (docs-25), plus webhook events including unsub/click/open (docs-18). However there is no explicit documentation of per-automation-step breakdowns of opens/clicks/unsubscribes/conversions over time, only campaign-level and general automation revenue attribution. missing for 10: automation step-level analytics dashboards, explicit unsubscribe trend reporting, time-series views combining all four metrics per step.
